contexts.text: The man is then delivered over to some harlot, and the woman to some adulterer.
They who have given themselves up to Divine worship...
When the understanding completely surrenders itself to the will... The love easily draws the understanding to its side, and hands it over.
All who have been delivered over to these loves...
To one who is enslaved to impiety...
This man is enslaved to Hell.
Like a servant who surrenders himself to some master...
They enslave a man, and do not leave him any freedom.
